days.headline: Land soft — home base first
days.morning: Travel day. No sightseeing. Head straight to Tokyo home base once you clear arrival.
days.afternoon: Unpack sleep spaces for toddler and infant. Map the nearest grocery and drugstore. Pick up breakfast staples, snacks, diapers/wipes, and any feeding supplies you did not pack.
days.evening: Easy takeout or convenience-store dinner. Lights out early. Protect the first night of sleep.
packing: Carry-on baby kit (diapers, wipes, spare clothes, feeding)

days.headline: Neighborhood rhythm, not a checklist
days.morning: Breakfast at home. Short walk to a nearby playground when the toddler is ready. Stay within an easy nap-return radius.
days.afternoon: Groceries and laundry. Long naps. Optional quiet café or park if energy is good — skip if anyone is still foggy.
days.evening: Home dinner. Early bedtime. DisneySea tickets are booked. Confirm tomorrow’s Ueno plan before sleep.
packing: Laundry bag / detergent pods if needed

days.headline: Ueno morning, Akihabara short, home by late afternoon
days.morning: Ueno Zoo or another family-friendly Ueno stop. Arrive when gates open if possible to beat crowds and protect nap timing.
days.afternoon: Lunch in Ueno. Short Akihabara visit only — one or two shops, not a deep dive. Aim home 4:30–5:00 pm.
days.evening: Prep DisneySea: KKday voucher loaded, park bag packed, early bedtime. No late plans.
packing: Stroller rain cover if forecast warrants
openQuestions: Ueno Zoo vs alternative Ueno attraction?

days.headline: DisneySea — highlight day, family pace wins
days.morning: Tickets are booked on KKday. Three adult 1-Day Passports (2 adults + nanny). Toddler (3y2m) and infant are free / no tickets. Arrive with buffer for security and stroller. Hit a first attraction while energy is high. Schedule an early snack.
days.afternoon: Midday meal and a real rest window (stroller nap / quiet corner). Drop lower-priority attractions without guilt.
days.evening: Early exit is a success. Direct route home. Simple dinner. Protect Nov 27 as recovery.

days.headline: Recovery day — leave it empty on purpose
days.morning: Sleep in. No alarms unless kids dictate otherwise. Breakfast at home.
days.afternoon: Laundry and restock. Nearby playground or easy mall only if everyone feels good. Otherwise stay put.
days.evening: Takeout. Light planning for Tsukiji tomorrow (leave time ~9–11 am). Confirm HASHIDA + nanny status.

days.morning: Tsukiji Outer Market ~9:00–11:00 am. Snacks or brunch. Keep walking loops short with the stroller.
days.afternoon: Straight home for long naps. Prep baby supplies and bedtime routine for the nanny handoff.
days.evening: Nanny handoff at Tokyo home base. Adults to HASHIDA TOKYO ~7:00 pm. Agree return time and emergency contacts before leaving.

days.evening: Home dinner. Light prep for Asakusa/Skytree tomorrow and Ginza Iwa handoff.

days.headline: Kawaguchiko overnight — scenic, not rushed
days.morning: Depart Tokyo with overnight bag only. Larger bags stay at Tokyo home base if the booking allows. Aim for mid-morning arrival buffer.
days.afternoon: Lunch by the lake. One or two scenic stops only if visibility and kids allow. Check into Fujikawaguchiko Airbnb.
days.evening: Easy dinner near lodging. Unhurried overnight. No late driving.

days.headline: Fuji morning, Tokyo afternoon, rest for Disneyland
days.morning: Breakfast with a view if weather cooperates. Relaxed checkout — do not squeeze extra stops.
days.afternoon: Return to Tokyo mid-afternoon. Unpack, laundry, restock. Home dinner.
days.evening: No plans. Early bedtime. Confirm Disneyland tickets and park hours for tomorrow.

days.headline: Disneyland — second Disney day, same rest rules
days.morning: Arrive with buffer. Prioritize a short list for the 3yo. Early snack and stroller nap window on the calendar.
days.afternoon: Meal break mid-park. Drop optional attractions. Early exit if energy dips.
days.evening: Direct home. Simple dinner. Keep Dec 4 daytime gentle ahead of the adult evening.

days.headline: Gentle neighborhoods by day, Bellwood then Sip by night
days.morning: Shinjuku Gyoen and a calm lunch. Short walking loops after yesterday’s park day.
days.afternoon: Harajuku/Meiji briefly, then Shibuya only if energy holds. Nanny handoff — kids and stroller back to Tokyo home base before 5 pm.
days.evening: ~5:00 pm Bell Sushi at The Bellwood → ~7:30 pm Sip / The SG Club. Reconfirm both reservations and return plan.

days.afternoon: Lunch in Toyosu. Continue to Odaiba for LEGOLAND Discovery Center. Other Odaiba stops optional — skip freely.
days.evening: Home dinner. Light packing start for Dec 7. No late plans.

days.headline: Flexible day — energy decides, packing is non-negotiable

days.afternoon: Final shopping only if light. Begin structured packing — kids’ bag, carry-on baby kit, documents.
days.evening: Home dinner. Lay out tomorrow’s clothes and airport-day bag. Confirm flight and transfer details.

days.headline: Checkout, buffer, fly — no sightseeing
